scope: Fixed component abstention compared with frozen closed reader on all 234 known development controls. No held-out or independent-object claim. All thresholds and qualification unchanged.

interpretation_limits.development: The new 36 conditions informed this gate and are no longer unseen. Preserve every old condition including the branch-negative task definition.
interpretation_limits.unidentifiable: Same-input semantic collisions are not included in pass/fail denominators; v5 cannot infer missing physical identity.
interpretation_limits.gap: Original gap proximity is reported without relaxed guards or success claims.
interpretation_limits.resolution: Unresolved is incomplete geometry, not background classification. Old zero-curve negative metric may hold without a resolved decision. Empty positive outputs remain failures; partial outputs retain all established axes and remain explicitly incomplete.

freeze_note: A valid legacy split proposal with inadequate valley evidence, or a supported split beyond the old depth limit, is unresolved and emits no axis. Other components proceed independently. Never tune after prepare.
